f2d6232345.why: The SSE2 reduction must preserve the intermediate xmm1 and xmm4 values and the full xmm0 result, leaving no removable shuffle, addition, shift, or packing step.

27d560518e.why: The live intermediate xmm1 and xmm4 values and the dependence on the incoming upper half of xmm0 prevent shortening the SSE2 reduction.

f8300edefa.why: Both loads, word subtractions, multiply-adds, and accumulations remain necessary even though xmm1 is scratch, and the pointer updates and comparison supply required final values.

ce4a043a3b.why: The live SSE2 reduction intermediates, arbitrary xmm7 correction, arithmetic shift, and signed saturation each require their existing operations.

db09dbcc55.why: Preserving xmm1 and the full xmm0 result requires the reduction steps, while SSE2 needs the comparison and selection sequence to produce both the signed minimum and the live xmm4 mask.

d6747799af.why: The reduction and shift remain necessary, and SSE2 has no signed dword minimum instruction to shorten the comparison and selection while retaining the xmm4 mask.

6226cb4c28.why: The live reduction intermediates and arbitrary xmm2 bound require the existing SSE2 reduction, shift, comparison, and selection operations.

a4ffbc73b4.why: The shifted dwords are not confined to signed words, so SSE2 word minimum instructions cannot replace the signed dword comparison and selection, and the reduction intermediates remain live.

cfcbbeca57.why: Neither the shifted dwords nor the arbitrary xmm2 bound permit a word minimum substitution, and the live xmm1 and xmm4 results prevent removing the reduction or comparison steps.

2dcac76ea6.why: The live reduction result, arbitrary xmm7 correction, shift, and SSE2 signed minimum sequence are all needed to preserve xmm0, xmm1, and the xmm4 comparison mask.

5ef55bf398.why: Each instruction independently produces a required result: two sign-extended indices, two zeroed vector registers, and the r11 copy.

cd52e7604b.why: The arbitrary xmm3 bytes and signed word coefficients require both unpack and multiply-add paths, whose results and accumulations are live along with the updated pointers and comparison flags.

c2312de04d.why: Two horizontal additions, an arithmetic shift, and signed packing already implement the reduction compactly, and the store and both integer register updates are required.

b23128677d.why: Both loaded vectors and multiply-add results feed live accumulators, and SSSE3 cannot fuse these operations or the required pointer updates and comparison.

77845ca507.why: The two horizontal additions, shift, and saturating pack are all necessary for arbitrary input dwords, followed by the required store and register updates.

c43ab902a8.why: SSSE3 already reduces both vectors in two horizontal additions, and the required arithmetic shift, saturation, store, and register updates cannot be eliminated.

e23c8c9baa.why: The compact horizontal reduction still needs a separate arithmetic shift and signed pack to preserve the complete xmm4 result and stored values.

65805eb9c2.why: The shifted sums can exceed the signed word range, so packing remains necessary after the two horizontal additions and shift, alongside the required store and register updates.

a642798c48.why: Both arbitrary word subtractions, signed multiply-adds, and accumulations produce live results, and the required pointer updates and comparison cannot be folded into those vector operations.

1091ea6b86.why: The arbitrary xmm7 correction must follow the horizontal sums before shifting and saturation, and SSSE3 provides no shorter sequence preserving the full xmm4 result and required stores and updates.
